build_mul_m: build a function to multiply vectors by the inertia matrix using sparse or dense kernels
run_xfrc_accumulate: run xfrc_accumulate to map applied forces at each body via Jacobians to DOF space
create_contact_force: create contact force computation for a list of contact IDs with optional world frame transform
test_jac: test the jac function to compute translational and rotational Jacobian for a point on a body
summarize_get_state: summarize get_state to copy concatenated state components from Data into a flat array by signature
